PluginData.Tooltip: Runs programmable block scripts in your own game instead of in a programmable block.
PluginData.Description:
Runs programmable block scripts in your own game instead of in a programmable block. Every script in its menu works like its own programmable block.
- Paste a script, or load one from the game's Browse Scripts (local and workshop). - Scripts compile with the game's own script compiler, whitelist and instruction limit. - Me, GridTerminalSystem, Runtime, Storage, Echo, Save(), UpdateFrequency and run arguments work as in a programmable block. - Works on multiplayer servers with nothing installed on the server.
Open it with /stp in chat.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineers/tree/main/Projects/Script%20to%20Plugin
